decision:
v1.6 (2026-08-14). RANK_OFFSETS REVERTED, and the freeze can now see wiring.

WHY REVERTED. RANK_OFFSETS were fitted on shape_sims.npz, which fit_shape2.py generated with the DEFAULT cut_n=65 for every event — the per-event cut rule (65/50/70/no-cut) shipped LATER THE SAME DAY. So they were fitted against a probability distribution the model no longer produces: the top-N tail of a 156-man field cut at 65 is not the tail of a 69-man no-cut playoff field.

MEASURED ON THE CURRENT MODEL (2026, summed LL over 6 placement markets, identical cached ratings, identical draws): base 1.66917 | refitted offsets 1.66907 (-0.0001, nothing) | SHIPPED offsets 1.68538 (+0.0162, actively harmful). A correct refit has the OPPOSITE sign at rank 1 (top5 -0.19 vs the shipped +0.71). There is no rank-conditional bias left once the cut rule is right. EXP-008 separately showed ordering is irrelevant (0.0009), so this was never an ordering bug.

⚠️ EVERY CHECK THAT BLESSED THE OFFSETS RAN INSIDE THE SAME STALE CHECKPOINT — +55.9 nats on the 2026 holdout, 8/8 markets, null on win, hurting when forced onto win. The train/holdout split was honest; the MODEL underneath both halves was wrong. A holdout cannot catch that, because it is not a data problem. A checkpoint is a snapshot of a MODEL, not of data.

NEW: the freeze now records call-site WIRING (recal_rank_called / recal_shape_called / inplay_shape_called). Disabling _recal_rank changed the model by 0.016 summed LL and the freeze reported INTACT, because the constant was still defined and every value still matched. A snapshot of values cannot see whether anything calls them. Same blindness class as G2 passing a constant-0.5 model and aggregate slope hiding a rank-conditional defect: a check that cannot fail the way the system actually breaks.

Machinery and the fitted table are KEPT but unwired, so the next person sees what was tried and why it failed.

No other model value moved. IN_PLAY_SHAPE_SLOPE 1.10, SHAPE_SLOPE 1.30 majors / fitted table non-majors, CUT_N 65 + per-event rule all unchanged.
purpose: frozen for the 2026 Rocket Classic G2 read (event unplayed at freeze time)
